custom_expected:
Step 5: FINANCE group is either hidden entirely or shows no QuickBooks entry.
Step 7: Direct URL navigation results in access denied / redirect to safe page.
custom_preconds: Custom role 'QB Test Role' exists with Settings parent ON but Finance sub-toggle OFF. A test user is assigned to that role.
custom_steps:
1. Log in as Administrator. Go to Roles & Permissions.
2. Open 'QB Test Role' for edit. In Page Access > Settings, confirm Finance sub-toggle is OFF.
3. Save.
4. Log out. Log in as the test user.
5. Open the left sidebar. Look for the FINANCE group.
6. If FINANCE group is visible, look for a QuickBooks entry inside it.
7. Attempt to navigate to the QuickBooks settings URL directly via the browser address bar.
title: QuickBooks settings are hidden when Settings > Finance sub-toggle is OFF
